title: Select a useful piece of state
summary: A selector is a function that reads state and returns the part a caller needs.
introduction: A selector is a function that reads state and returns the part a caller needs. Your task: Add another unread record and predict the count.
learningObjectives: Add another unread record and predict the count.
Explain the example for select a useful piece of state

blocks.text: A selector is a function that reads state and returns the part a caller needs. It keeps state lookup rules in one place.
Use a JavaScript project with @reduxjs/toolkit installed. React examples also need react-redux and React. These imports require your project build tool and are not available in the plain playground.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A selector should read and calculate. It should not dispatch actions or change the state it receives.
